title: Fixed-G2 Floyd stall oracle with zero-delete collision pool and charged escapes

claims.statement: For a supplied nonidentity Q in BLS12-381 G2 and uniform z in its prime-order target group, the proposed classical Floyd-plus-distinguished-point-pool algorithm targets recovery of P=[x]P0 satisfying e(P,Q)=z with success at least 39/100 and total work at most 2^(2567/20) dense-Fp12-operation equivalents at C=20000, including setup, failures, routing, verification and output. The production trail has no per-trail escape cap: every in-place offset is charged one dense product plus 55000 instructions, the trail itself terminates at 3T evaluations, and the priced global first-moment allowance bounds the escape residual by 1/128 of the modelled recovery reference. With that single escape row the modelled success floor is 0.5461, clearing the 0.39 requirement; the bound stays conditional on the named first-moment premises for pool, report, transport and escape counts.
